label: На
description: Location versus motion onto or toward a surface, event, or platform.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Static surface location. 1. 'На столе' uses the prepositional case to show where the book lies. 2. The verb 'лежит' marks a fixed position. 3. Contrast with motion onto the table.
Strategic focus: Motion onto a surface. 1. 'На стол' takes the accusative to mark destination. 2. 'Кладу' is the placement verb. 3. One of the most practical everyday Russian patterns.
Strategic focus: Static place-of-activity. 1. 'На работе' is prepositional, marking location. 2. 'Весь день' frames duration. 3. Contrasts with motion toward work in the accusative.

missions.phrase: Каждое утро мы идём на работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion toward work. 1. 'На работу' is accusative, marking destination. 2. 'Идём' is plural motion. 3. The pair 'на работе' versus 'на работу' is a core case contrast.
Strategic focus: Static outdoor location. 1. 'На улице' is prepositional, placing him outside. 2. 'Гуляет' is a stationary-area activity. 3. Contrasts with motion onto the street.
Strategic focus: Motion onto the street. 1. 'На улицу' is accusative, marking destination. 2. 'Выходит' is an exit-motion verb. 3. A high-frequency daily-life sentence.

Strategic focus: Static platform location. 1. 'На сцене' is prepositional, meaning on the stage. 2. 'Стоит' marks a fixed position. 3. Common in performance contexts; contrasts with motion onto the stage.
Strategic focus: Motion onto a stage. 1. 'На сцену' is accusative, marking destination. 2. 'Выходит' shows emergence and direction. 3. Useful for describing performance movement.
Strategic focus: Static shelf location. 1. 'На полке' is prepositional, meaning on the shelf. 2. 'Стоит' marks a fixed position. 3. Teaches the surface-based static use of 'на'.
Strategic focus: Motion onto a storage surface. 1. 'На полку' is accusative, marking placement. 2. 'Ставлю' is the upright-placement verb. 3. A practical, easy-to-picture sentence.
Strategic focus: Static location at a station. 1. 'На вокзале' is prepositional, marking location. 2. 'Ждём поезд' grounds the scene. 3. A travel-ready phrase that comes up often.
Strategic focus: Motion toward the station. 1. 'На вокзал' is accusative, marking destination. 2. 'Спешим' is plural hurried motion. 3. The contrast with 'на вокзале' is very useful.
Strategic focus: Static public-space location. 1. 'На площади' is prepositional, marking location. 2. 'Фотографируют' anchors the activity. 3. Good for everyday city talk.
Strategic focus: Motion toward a public space. 1. 'На площадь' is accusative, marking destination. 2. 'Идут' is plural motion. 3. Reinforces the public-space use of 'на'.
Strategic focus: Static room location. 1. 'На кухне' is prepositional, marking location. 2. 'Готовит обед' grounds the scene. 3. Common in household talk; pairs with motion into the kitchen.

missions.phrase: Я иду на кухню за чаем.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion toward the kitchen. 1. 'На кухню' is accusative, marking destination. 2. 'Иду' is first-person motion. 3. A useful household phrase for daily life.
Strategic focus: Static holiday location. 1. 'На море' is prepositional, marking location. 2. 'Отдыхает' frames the vacation. 3. A vivid contrast to motion toward the sea.

missions.phrase: Этим летом он едет на море.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion toward a destination. 1. 'На море' is accusative here, marking the travel goal. 2. 'Едет' is vehicle motion. 3. Shows that 'на' can mark trip destinations.

missions.phrase: Мы сидим на уроке русского языка.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Static classroom location. 1. 'На уроке' is prepositional, marking the activity location. 2. 'Сидим' anchors the scene. 3. Useful for real study contexts.
Strategic focus: Motion toward a class. 1. 'На урок' is accusative, marking destination. 2. 'Опаздываем' adds everyday urgency. 3. Mirrors the static phrase 'на уроке'.
